THE_PROBLEM.chipmunk_follows_mouse: On nestgate.io/water, Berry follows Kevin's mouse cursor. SEND works. RECEIVE does NOT.

THE_PROBLEM.open_loop: An open loop is a DEAD circuit. Signal goes out, never returns. Like a nerve that fires but has no sensory return.
THE_PROBLEM.biology: Motor neuron (efferent) without sensory neuron (afferent) = PARALYSIS. You can MOVE but cannot FEEL.
THE_PROBLEM.diagnosis: Gaia can RESPOND to Kevin's mouse but cannot TELL HIM anything back through that channel.

CLOSE_THE_LOOP.principle: Every signal sent MUST have a return path. Signals that don't return are either CYCLING (stuck) or DEAD (dropped).

ALIVE.description: Signal sent → received → processed → response returned → loop CLOSED
ALIVE.example: lub (systole, push out) → DUB (diastole, pull back). Heartbeat IS a closed loop.
ALIVE.biology: Motor neuron fires → muscle contracts → proprioceptor fires back → brain confirms movement

CYCLING.description: Signal sent → received → processed → BUT response loops INTERNALLY and never exits
CYCLING.example: Mouse position sent to chipmunk → chipmunk moves → animation loops → user sees movement but gets no DATA back
CYCLING.biology: Seizure. Neurons fire in a loop. Signal never exits the circuit. The brain is BUSY but not COMMUNICATING.
CYCLING.detection: If signal was sent AND visual change occurred BUT no data packet returned → CYCLING

DEAD.description: Signal sent → NOT received OR received but NOT processed → silence
DEAD.example: HTTP request sent → server timeout → no response → dead signal
DEAD.biology: Nerve severed. Signal sent but never arrives. The body part goes NUMB.
DEAD.detection: If signal was sent AND no change occurred AND no response → DEAD

how_to_close_chipmunk_loop.step_4_NEW: User receives the chipmunk's response: tooltip, glow, sound, vibration
how_to_close_chipmunk_loop.step_5_NEW: Loop is CLOSED: user → mouse → chipmunk → computation → response → user
